race.description: Bendigo Mazda Hcp MCC Series Ht 2 (Bm66)
race.comment: OUR JUSTIFY (13) looks the one to beat. She's been very consistent throughout her career having only missed a place once and is coming off a good win here over 1400m, sent out the $2.50 favourite and running on well to score. Can't see the step up in trip posing an issue and she can win again. KASTUN STAR (5) has won two on the bounce, backing up the easy Mornington victory with a good effort at Cranbourne. Bit harder here but should take beating again. GLENFINNAN (12) presents third up and ready to win having shown nice improvement second up when second to a progressive one in town. Don't love the draw but he'll take holding out. UNTAPPED (4) wasn't far behind OUR JUSTIFY last time and is in the mix again. EISHAA (3) is flying and can measure up again despite a tricky gate.
